prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Signature and Persona Redesign: Rebuilds the adoption certificate layout into a full-bleed official adoption record featuring a verified companion badge and formal pet naming prompt. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.9% with a 1017s mean time; strengthening the emotional commitment and visual polish helps lock in user engagement.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Order Shift: Moves sign-in directly after adoption certificate completion so users secure their account right after bonding with and naming their pet. (why: 8 support emails report missing or reset pets after signing in. Placing sign-in right after pet creation ensures immediate account backup and prevents loss.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Behavior Preview Sub-Flow: Inserts a dynamic behavior preview screen prior to path selection so users can watch desktop pets act out different daily routines before committing. (why: Mean duration on choose_path is high (514s), indicating user indecision during early path selection.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly confirm that logging in restores previously adopted pets. (why: The largest cluster of support emails (8 tickets) comes from users confused about pets missing or reset after signing in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Asset Generation Stage Progress Indicator: Configures the waiting screen into a structured stage layout with step progress indicators and estimated render times while pet assets construct. (why: Mean waiting step time is 2336s and 3 support tickets mention app stalling or pets failing to display on desktop.)
5: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Pick Friend Persona Layout: Replaces the pick_friend layout with a two-column display separating visual pet artwork from personality trait details. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop in the funnel (69.9% conversion); clear visual organization reduces decision fatigue.)
6: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification Toggle: Enables a background desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during long pet asset builds. (why: Mean waiting step time is 2336s (~38 mins), causing drop-off if users feel stuck staring at a loading screen.)
